components.note: 氵 (water) — 三点水 marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 酒 liquor, 河 river; 汤 is soup or hot water.
昜 (yáng) — near sound — 汤 is tāng; 昜 also sounds out 扬 yáng, 场 chǎng, 烫 tàng.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women and female roles, as in 妈 mom, 姐 sister, 姑 aunt; 姆 is a nanny, as in 保姆.
母 (mǔ) — same sound — 姆 is mǔ, just like 母 (mother).
牛 (ox, cattle) — 牛 marks cattle and animals, as in 牲, 物, 特; 牺 was a pure sacrificial ox.
西 (xī) — same sound — 牺 is xī, like 西 west.
牛 (ox, cattle) — 牛 for cattle and livestock, as in 牺, 物, 特; 牲 is a sacrificial or domestic animal.
生 (shēng) — same sound — 牲 is shēng, like 生; the pair 牺牲 means sacrifice.
力 (strength) — 力 marks strength and effort, as in 办, 动, 努, 助; 勇 is strength in action, courage.
甬 (yǒng) — same sound — 勇 is yǒng, like 甬; 甬 also sounds out 通 tōng, 痛 tòng, 桶 tǒng.
忄 (heart) — 忄 is the heart radical for emotions, as in 怕, 情, 慌; 愤 is anger and resentment.
贲 (bēn) — near sound — 愤 is fèn; 贲 also sounds out 喷 pēn.
心 (heart) — 心 marks emotions and thought, as in 想, 思, 急; 怒 is rage.
奴 (nú) — same sound, different tone — 怒 is nù; 奴 also sounds out 努 nǔ.
艹 (grass, plants) — 艹 marks plants; 范 was originally a plant name, and later pattern or model, as in 范围 scope.
氾 (fàn) — same sound — 范 is fàn, like 氾.
阝 (mound, hill) — left-side 阝 is 阜 (mound), as in 阴, 院, 队; 阳 is the sunny side of a hill, with 日 sun.
日 (sun) — 日 is the sun, as in 明, 晴, 时.
日 (sun) — 日 stands for day and time, as in 时, 晚, 早; 暂 is "for a short time".
斩 (zhǎn) — near sound — 暂 is zàn; 斩 also sounds out 渐 jiàn and 惭 cán.
亻 (person) — person radical — 优 first meant a person who performs or is excellent, in 演员 and 优秀.
尤 (yóu) — near sound — 优 is yōu; 尤 also sounds out 忧 yōu.
禾 (grain) — 禾 is the grain plant, as in 种, 秋; 秀 first meant a plant coming into flower or ear, then graceful and outstanding.
曲 (bent) — the shape pictures something bent; qū means crooked and qǔ means a song, as in 歌曲.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women and family terms, as in 妈, 姐, 姑; 婴 is an infant, as in 婴儿.
忄 (heart) — 忄 is the heart radical for feelings, as in 情, 怕; 惜 is the feeling of cherishing.
昔 (xī) — same sound — 惜 is xī, like 昔 (in the past); 昔 also sounds out 借 jiè and 错 cuò.
石 (stone) — a rock 口 at the foot of a cliff 厂; as a radical it marks stones and minerals, as in 破, 码, 砖, 磨.
禾 (grain) — 禾 is grain, as in 种, 秋; 科 first meant grading grain with a measure 斗, and then categories like 科学.
斗 (dipper) — 斗 is a measuring dipper, as in 斗 (a unit of grain).
舟 (boat) — 舟 is the boat radical, as in 般, 航, 舰; 船 is a ship.
厂 (shelter) — 厂 here stands for a building; the traditional 廳 had 广, a wide hall.
丁 (dīng) — near sound — 厅 is tīng; 丁 also sounds out 订 dìng and 顶 dǐng.
足 (foot) — 足 (⻊) marks feet and walking, as in 跑, 跳, 路; 距 is the gap between two steps.
巨 (jù) — same sound — 距 is jù; 巨 also sounds out 拒 jù and 矩 jǔ.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言 (speech), as in 说, 话, 读; 讲 is to talk and explain.
井 (jǐng) — near sound — 讲 is jiǎng; the old form had a different right side, so this is only a loose hint.
自 (self, nose) — 自 originally pictured a nose — pointing to it meant "me", as in 自己; 鼻 adds 畀 for sound.
畀 (bì) — near sound — 鼻 is bí.
彳 (step, conduct) — 彳 is a step or going, as in 行 and 往; 德 is conduct.
心 (heart) — 心 is the heart — the old 悳 was a straight 直 heart, so upright inner conduct.
穴 (hole, cave) — 穴 marks holes and cavities, as in 空, 穷, 突; 窗 is an opening in a wall.
囱 (cōng) — near sound — 窗 is chuāng; 囱 also sounds out 葱 cōng and 聪 cōng.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进, 送; 迹 is a footprint, as in 奇迹 miracle.
亦 (yì) — near sound — 迹 is jì; 亦 also sounds out 迹 jì.
衤 (clothing) — 衤 is the clothing radical, as in 衣, 裤, 衬; 被 is a quilt, then the passive marker.
皮 (pí) — loose hint — 被 is bèi; 皮 also sounds out 披 pī and 坡 pō.
忄 (heart) — 忄 is the heart radical for feelings, as in 情, 怕; 悔 is regret.
每 (měi) — loose hint — 悔 is huǐ; 每 also sounds out 梅 méi and 海 hǎi.
亻 (person) — person radical — 仰 is a person looking up, as in 信仰 belief.
卬 (áng) — near sound — 仰 is yǎng; 卬 also sounds out 迎 yíng.
女 (woman) — 女 marks women, as in 妈, 姐; 媒 is a matchmaker, as in 媒体 media.
某 (mǒu) — near sound — 媒 is méi; 某 also sounds out 煤 méi and 谋 móu.
讠 (speech) — 讠 is the simplified 言, as in 说, 话; 谓 is to call or say, as in 所谓.
胃 (wèi) — same sound — 谓 is wèi; 胃 also sounds out 渭 wèi.
化 (change) — one person 亻 beside an upside-down person 匕 — a change of state; 化 is to change, as in 文化 and 变化.
车 (cart) — 车 is a cart; 辈 first meant rows of war carts, hence ranks and generations.
非 (fēi) — near sound — 辈 is bèi; 非 also sounds out 悲 bēi and 排 pái.
亻 (person) — person radical; 仅 is the simplified form of 僅.
又 (yòu) — in the old form 僅 the sound came from 堇 (jǐn); 仅 and 谨 jǐn sound the same.
化 (huà) — near sound — 华 is huá; 化 also changes tone to sound out 华.
十 (ten) — the bottom 十 is a simplified remnant; 华 is flowery and splendid, as in 中华.
皿 (dish) — 皿 is a dish, as in 盘, 盖, 盒; 盛 is to fill a dish, then abundant.
成 (chéng) — near sound — 盛 is shèng; 成 also sounds out 城 chéng and 诚 chéng.
页 (head) — 页 is the head, as in 题, 顶, 领; 顿 is to bow the head and then pause.
屯 (tún) — near sound — 顿 is dùn; 屯 also sounds out 钝 dùn and 炖 dùn.
目 (eye) — 目 marks the eye and looking, as in 看, 眼, 睛; 瞧 is to look.
焦 (jiāo) — near sound — 瞧 is qiáo; 焦 also sounds out 憔 qiáo.
子 (child) — 子 means child, as in 孩, 孙; 孤 is a lone child, an orphan.
瓜 (guā) — near sound — 孤 is gū; 瓜 also sounds out 狐 hú and 弧 hú.
工 (tool, work) — originally a carpenter's square held in a hand — the same word as 矩; 巨 also sounds out 距 jù and 拒 jù.
心 (heart) — 心 marks thought and feelings, as in 想, 急; 惩 is to make someone feel sorry through punishment.
征 (zhēng) — near sound — 惩 is chéng; 征 also sounds out 证 zhèng.
刂 (knife) — 刂 is 刀 (knife) as in 到, 别, 利; punishing was once done by cutting.
讠 (speech) — 讠 (言, words) — 罚 originally also meant scolding.
艹 (grass, plants) — 艹 marks plants; 蓝 is the indigo plant from which blue dye was made.
监 (jiān) — loose hint — 蓝 is lán; 监 also sounds out 篮 lán and 滥 làn.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进, 送; 退 is to step back.
牛 (ox, cattle) — 牛 is cattle, as in 牺, 牲, 物; 牧 shows a hand with a stick 攵 herding cattle.
攵 (tap, strike) — 攵 is a hand with a stick, as in 教, 放.
王 (jade) — 王 on the left is 玉 (jade) as in 玩, 球, 现; 环 is a jade ring, as in 环境.
